'''Tegan''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] who was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. A veteran officer in [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Grol]]'s unit, after Grol's [[Death/Legends|death]] he clashed with the more junior Sergeant [[Pratt]] over who would assume command of the unit and continue their mission to extract [[Padrus Organa]] from [[House Alde (estate)|House Alde]].
